name: embrace_key
desc: Keep the layout, sizes and both monster designs exactly. The pink goo crocodile (left, facing right) and the pink goo Doberman (right, facing left) embrace each other tightly chest to chest: each wraps its thick arms around the other's back, and the small black witch cat is squashed and trapped between their two broad chests, only its head, hat, paws and tail poking out, struggling with eyes squeezed shut. Thick, stretchy pink goo strands glue all three together and drip down; their lower bodies melt together into one shared puddle. Both grin smugly at each other over the cat's hat. Same colors, yellow marble streaks, outline and pixel art style as the original sprites. Transparent background.
